channel.title: News Talk 980 CKNW - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: Former Edmonton cadets instructor charged with historic sexual assaults
item.description: Edmonton police allege three teenage boys, who were cadets, were sexually assaulted on separate occasions between 2009 and 2016 by a man who was their cadet instructor.

item.title: Prince Rupert man feared a ‘hit’ had been ordered before his family’s death, inquest hears
item.description: Police told the inquest Christopher Duong was known to officers and allegedly involved in the Prince Rupert drug trade before he was found dead with his wife and two young kids.

item.title: ‘Hard to believe’: Almost one year since B.C. mother Jennifer Provencal disappeared
item.description: 'There's no way she would have just walked away from her family and home,' neighbour Lee Hunter said. 'There's just no way. She was not that kind of mother.'

item.title: Okanagan Nation Alliance among Indigenous groups issuing travel advisory to U.S.
item.description: Indigenous travellers crossing the border into the United States are being warned to exercise extreme caution amid an increasingly tense political climate.

item.title: Canadian brand spotlight: Get to know Jenny Bird
item.description: Homegrown and glimmering, these pieces are designed for the modern, confident, and style-conscious woman who values both design and substance.

item.title: Over 100 Côte Saint-Luc residents still without heat after power outage
item.description: The prolonged outage has now become the subject of a proposed class action lawsuit.

item.title: Douglas Hospital flooding causes major setback for leading Alzheimer’s and mental health researchers
item.description: On Jan. 26, several pipes in the Lehmann building burst, causing widespread flooding and damage.

item.title: Extra Alberta ER doctor shifts delayed amid talks between government, physicians
item.description: The new E.R. triage shifts are meant for doctors to help speed up patient assessments and diagnostic work, and in some cases begin providing care in the waiting room.

item.title: Harley’s OT winner lifts Dallas past Winnipeg Jets 4-3
item.description: Gabriel Vilardi, Cole Perfetti and Logan Stanley scored for the Jets who fell to 1-6 in games decided in OT this season.

item.title: Nylander nets 3 points as Leafs outlast Flames 4-2
item.description: William Nylander scored his 18th goal of the season and added two assists to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 4-2 NHL victory over the Calgary Flames on Monday.
